c: On a list of CIs in the CMDB Workspace, choose Create CI. It needs sn_cmdb_editor or cmdb_manual_ci_ire_access.
say: On a list of configuration items in the CMDB workspace, choose create CI. You need the CMDB editor role, or the manual CI creation role.

c: Select the class for the new CI. Classes without identification rules can't be chosen.
say: Select the class of the new CI. Only classes with identification rules can be chosen.

c: Fill the Identifier entries, then Operational status, Location, Managed by group and Owned by.
say: Fill the identifier entries, the values that tell this CI apart. Then the operational status, location, managed by group and owned by.

c: Add relationship(s) to other CIs, people or groups, so the CI isn't an orphan.
say: Add relationships to other CIs, people or groups, so the new CI is not left an orphan.

c: Create checks the CMDB first, then creates the CI and its relationships.
say: Choose create. The CMDB is checked first; if nothing matches, the CI is created with its relationships.

c: If it matches a CI: CI already exists, and Review existing CI. Nothing new is created.
say: If a CI with the same identifying values exists, you are told it already exists and can review it. Nothing new is created.

c: On classes without identification rules the list shows New: a plain form, with no duplicate check. Search first.
say: On classes without identification rules, the list shows new instead. It opens a plain form with no duplicate check, so search first.
